difference: The previous53-readout construction required affine sums mI+A_j. This construction gives explicit positive source words and separates exterior recurrence degrees instead. The v862 monomial-word obstruction concerns a different alphabet; the actual D2 here is not monomial. Normalized-amplitude and Haar-half-form kills are not bypassed: final objects are ordinary trace-class Fock operators, but their unbounded constituent pullbacks are not claimed executable quantum gates. No global positivity, no fitted Weil Gram, no critical-zero data and no prime oracle is used.

object: Freeze arithmetic alphabet {a,f,u,v,D2} in the actual complex4 quaternionic chart. The pure positive word R=D2^2(u D2 u^3)(v D2 v^3) has reduced norm16 and R*R>(5/4)I. The unit-word trace Gram has determinant4^16; invert it for Z=gR^13 and recover g=ZR^-13. The 256 fixed readouts replace the prior freely additive mI+A probes.
